name: Green screen
description: Keys out the green behind the subject and puts a background picture or video there (without a background the tracks below show through).
description_de: Stanzt das Grün hinter der Person aus und setzt dort ein Hintergrundbild oder -video ein (ohne Hintergrund scheinen die Spuren darunter durch).
description_en: Keys out the green behind the subject and puts a background picture or video there (without a background the tracks below show through).
description_es: Elimina el verde detrás del sujeto y coloca allí una imagen o un vídeo de fondo (sin fondo se ven las pistas de abajo).
description_fr: Détoure le vert derrière le sujet et place à la place une image ou une vidéo d'arrière-plan (sans arrière-plan, les pistes en dessous apparaissent).
description_pl: Usuwa zieleń za osobą i wstawia tam obraz lub film tła (bez tła widać ścieżki poniżej).
description_ru: Вырезает зелёный фон за объектом и ставит туда фоновую картинку или видео (без фона просвечивают дорожки ниже).

background.description: picture or video behind the subject

tolerance.description: how far from the screen color still counts as screen (0..1)

spill.description: removes the screen color's tint on the subject (0..1)

grow.description: moves the matte edge in project pixels (negative = shrink)

soften.description: blurs the matte edge in project pixels
